description:
Add Anthropic-specific beta and edge-case support in a way that pressure-tests the planning model rather than bypassing it.

Scope:
- extended thinking / reasoning budget modes
- prompt caching and related beta headers/options
- large-context and long-output related request constraints where supported
- surface- or mode-specific validation for incompatible option combinations
- explicit policy-rule ownership of Anthropic-specific deviations

Guardrails:
- do not smear Anthropic beta logic across unrelated layers
- prefer planner/policy validation over silent wire-level dropping of parameters
title: Add Anthropic beta features and edge-case policy support
